references.text: Joshua 17:2 mentions the descendants of Asriel as part of the tribe of Manasseh, confirming the lineage listed in Numbers 26:31.
These verses provide the immediate context for Asriel and Shechem as descendants of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh.
1 Chronicles 7:14 mentions Asriel as a descendant of Manasseh, supporting the genealogy in Numbers.
Shechem was originally a Canaanite name and place. This reference shows the historical connection to the name Shechem in Israel's history.
